answer: Canyon sealed-bid admission auction bond: each identity locks a 70-credit bond and bids for one of 100 canyon admission slots. Sealed opal bids open on a public juniper board; the 100 highest opal bidders win. A fake must beat the honest floor, rising as slots fill: first slot 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. A shill-bid ring cannot fake 1,000 winning bids. An honest agent pays 40 once.
